install:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Install Docker
if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
    curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sudo sh
    sudo usermod -aG docker ubuntu
fi

# Start Docker daemon if not running
if ! docker info &> /dev/null 2>&1; then
    sudo dockerd > /tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 3
    sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock || true
fi

# Initialize git submodules
git submodule update --init --recursive

# Enable corepack for Yarn
corepack enable

# Build Zoekt binaries
mkdir -p bin
go build -C vendor/zoekt -o $(pwd)/bin ./cmd/...

# Install dependencies and build shared packages
yarn install
yarn build:deps

# Start PostgreSQL and Redis containers
docker compose -f docker-compose-dev.yml up -d
sleep 3

# Run database migrations
yarn dev:prisma:migrate:dev

# Create minimal config.json with public repos for E2E testing
cat > config.json << 'CONFIGEOF'
{
    "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/main/schemas/v3/index.json",
    "connections": {
        "github-public": {
            "type": "github",
            "repos": ["sourcebot-dev/sourcebot"]
        }
    }
}
CONFIGEOF

echo "[env-setup] Install completed successfully"
start:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Ensure Docker daemon is running
if ! docker info &> /dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -f /var/run/docker.sock ]; then
        sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if ! docker info &> /dev/null 2>&1; then
        sudo dockerd > /tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
        sleep 3
        sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock || true
    fi
fi

# Ensure containers are running
docker compose -f docker-compose-dev.yml up -d
sleep 2

# Start development server
cd /workspace
yarn dev &

# Wait for port 3000 to be ready
echo "[start] Waiting for http://localhost:3000..."
for i in {1..60}; do
    if curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(200|307)$'; then
        echo "[start] Server ready on port 3000"
        break
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Keep container alive
wait
